bands.note: Hart's own layers; the D2D fields in CAVE use 925-700 and 500-300 hPa

track_b: track motion (hbt, clst); hb and cls are the gridded field's steering-flow values

hysteresis.note: clsh keeps the previous hour's class until B is above b_hi (asymmetric) or below b_lo (symmetric), or a thermal wind term is more than vt_m beyond zero; margin is the distance in m to the nearest wall that would change the raw class (B does not enter class 6)
